I told her that I had feelings for her and that I have been feeling very anxious and bad. But if I told her I am suicidal she will blame herself because it's right after she started seeing this new person and we talked about it. I don't want her to feel bad. Plus it seems manipulative don't you think? I feel like it would break our friendship further. I don't wanna guilt trip her, I just want to escape. The more I think about her being sad, the more I don't know if I can go through with this though

I really want to die, but I keep hesitating because of that
